lines: I already knew the truth
how much you love that person
how deeply you love them
I, standing beside you
have no chance at all
I already knew that too
you are falling in love
and I, at your side
quietly fell in love with you
you smile without noticing anything
I have been watching your profile
From the start
I only wish for your happiness
even if that happiness isn’t with me
I’ll see it through to the end
so my hidden yearning won’t be found
I’ll push you forward from beside you
and make you happier than anyone else can
What you’re doing now
is the story I never want to hear
Yet I keep listening
because it’s still better than never seeing you again
that’s a little bit better
What I wanted to hear
was not even at the last train hour
nor a complaint about the one you love
I just wanted you to notice
the hair I cut for today
and tell me it suits me
From the start
I only wish for your happiness
even if that happiness isn’t with me
I’ll see it through to the end
so my hidden yearning won’t be found
I’ll push you forward from beside you
stay a little longer here
before I fell this deeply
I wonder if I could have met you elsewhere
I chose, I hoped, I fell in love
even if it never comes true
even if I can’t convey my feelings
I want to cherish that I felt this way
It’s true, I mean it
I miss you
but even when you’re beside me
it still hurts
I fell for you before that person
but still
if you love me as much as I love you
then perhaps I’m still not enough
From the start
I only wish for your happiness
even if that happiness isn’t with me
I’ll see it through to the end
so my hidden yearning won’t be found
I’ll push you forward from beside you
and make you happier than anyone else can
that’s all I can do
